title: Report status and time labels
responsibility: Formats report activity status, stale state, timestamps and evidence anchors.

inputs.name: reportDisplay.report
inputs.description: Report whose lifecycle and update time determine display status.

inputs.name: reportStale.now
inputs.description: Optional current epoch milliseconds, defaulting to Date.now().

inputs.name: timeAgo.now
inputs.description: Optional current epoch milliseconds, defaulting to Date.now().

inputs.name: evidenceAnchor.id
inputs.description: Evidence identifier used in an anchor.

outputs.name: reportDisplay
outputs.description: Finalized report status unchanged; otherwise interrupted after more than 15 minutes without an update, or running.

outputs.name: reportStale
outputs.description: True only for a nonfinalized report more than 15 minutes past its update time.

outputs.name: dateLabel
outputs.description: Timestamp formatted in en-GB with medium date and short local time.

outputs.name: timeAgo
outputs.description: English relative age using the largest supported unit and whole elapsed units. Under one minute, including future dates, reads just now; invalid timestamps return empty.

outputs.name: evidenceAnchor
outputs.description: evidence- followed by the supplied identifier.
